entries.title: I Timothy 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ, according to [the] command of God our Saviour, and of Christ Jesus our hope,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:2
segments: to Timotheus, [my] true child in faith: grace, mercy, peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:3
segments: Even as I begged thee to remain in Ephesus, [when I was] going to Macedonia, that thou mightest enjoin some not to teach other doctrines,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:4
segments: nor to turn their minds to fables and interminable genealogies, which bring questionings rather than [further] God's dispensation, which [is] in faith.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:5
segments: ¶But the end of what is enjoined is love out of a pure heart and a good conscience and unfeigned faith;

entries.title: I Timothy 1:6
segments: which [things] some having missed, have turned aside to vain discourse,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:7
segments: desiring to be law-teachers, not understanding either what they say or concerning what they [so] strenuously affirm.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:8
segments: Now we know that the law [is] good if any one uses it lawfully,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:9
segments: knowing this, that law has not its application to a righteous person, but to [the] lawless and insubordinate, to [the] impious and sinful, to [the] unholy and profane, to smiters of fathers and smiters of mothers; to murderers,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:10
segments: fornicators, sodomites, kidnappers, liars, perjurers; and if any other thing is opposed to sound teaching,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:11
segments: according to the glad tidings of the glory of the blessed God, with which *I* have been entrusted.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:12
segments: ¶[And] I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me power, that he has counted me faithful, appointing to ministry him

entries.title: I Timothy 1:13
segments: who before was a blasphemer and persecutor, and an insolent overbearing [man]: but mercy was shewn me because I did it ignorantly, in unbelief.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:14
segments: But the grace of our Lord surpassingly over-abounded with faith and love, which [is] in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:15
segments: Faithful [is] the word, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom *I* am [the] first.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:16
segments: But for this reason mercy was shewn me, that in me, [the] first, Jesus Christ might display the whole long-suffering, for a delineation of those about to believe on him to life eternal.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:17
segments: Now to the King of the ages, [the] incorruptible, invisible, only God, honour and glory to the ages of ages. Amen.

entries.title: I Timothy 1:18
segments: ¶This charge, [my] child Timotheus, I commit to thee, according to the prophecies as to thee preceding, in order that thou mightest war by them the good warfare,

entries.title: I Timothy 1:19
segments: maintaining faith and a good conscience; which [last] some, having put away, have made shipwreck as to faith;

entries.title: I Timothy 1:20
segments: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have delivered to Satan, that they may be taught by discipline not to blaspheme.
